hero.title: Your greenhouse climate and watering on one screen
hero.subtitle: Organize sensors, lighting and watering by greenhouse and plant. View history, configure automations and try them on the demo farm. Connect your existing Zigbee2MQTT setup or start with one sensor.
hero.preview_alt: GrowerHub demo farm: four greenhouses with climate, watering and lighting
hero.preview_caption: A demo farm in the same app: open charts, water plants and try your own settings.

secondary.title: Start with your current setup
secondary.text: If Home Assistant and Zigbee2MQTT already work, use the local bridge. First check that one sensor shows fresh readings, then add growing zones and controls.

points.title: What you need
points.text: A compatible Zigbee coordinator, a sensor and an always-on computer running Zigbee2MQTT. GrowerHub needs an internet connection.

points.title: What is free
points.text: The dashboard, sensor history and available automations are currently free, with no payment card required. Hardware is purchased separately.

points.title: Your first result
points.text: Readings and their freshness on one page. If the connection is lost, readings become stale and server automations wait for connectivity to return.

items.title: Unified overview
items.text: Zones, device states and latest readings in one dashboard.

items.title: Sensor history
items.text: Track temperature, humidity and other metrics exposed by Zigbee2MQTT over time.

items.title: Manual control
items.text: Commands are only available for control capabilities that the device has advertised and enabled by GrowerHub.

items.title: Automation
items.text: Light schedule, climate thresholds with hysteresis and watering with customizable protective limits.

early_access: GrowerHub grew out of extensive practical experience in greenhouse automation. We have brought monitoring, control and clear automation scenarios together in one platform that is already free to use without a card. If you need help or support for a new device model, message us in Telegram — we can help in Russian or English.
title: GrowerHub — greenhouse sensors, irrigation and climate
description: Manage greenhouse sensors, irrigation, lighting and climate in one dashboard. Try a ready-made demo without signing up, or connect your own Zigbee2MQTT.
